section:
### Additional comparison

Standard care is the usual blood pressure treatment given to every patient. Cardivel is a tablet that slows the heart so it pushes with less force. The groups in this comparison were followed at the Northgate Heart Cohort.

Table 6. The measure for each arm, shown subset by subset.

| Subset | Arm | Measure | Count | Total |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Older adults, Reduced kidney function, University hospital | Standard care | Blood pressure control | 297 | 550 |
| Older adults, Reduced kidney function, University hospital | Cardivel | Blood pressure control | 371 | 550 |

These values are listed for every arm and every subset.
